description:
Hassle-free screen blackout and awake modes that keep your PC, Apps & AI ticking.

KiT is a quiet Windows companion with three modes. Light keeps the machine
awake - a true caffeine alternative. Night offers wakeable dark with deep
screen and clear desk, while the PC keeps working. Night includes four
screensaver faces (Cosmos, DVD, Snake, Orbit), tray Night brightness for
Windows plus monitor, virtual desk that prevents window shuffle, blue and
teal UFO warp tracers, Kit Commander letter rain, and spatial collision polish
at the panel's own refresh. Off returns ordinary Windows.

Optional Ghost bar (transparent, click-through), optional Hold Night,
optional run at sign-in, remembers how you left it, single instance, GitHub
release auto-updater, Offer trains, denser cosmos. Entirely local. No
telemetry. No fake input.
